jsonld_raw.name: AQUA BERGAMOTA CAR AIR FRESHENER
jsonld_raw.description:
Car air freshener with a clip.

Aqua Bergamota | A fresh aroma that transports you to the Mediterranean. An invigorating fragrance introduced by a sparkling infusion of bergamot and pink grapefruit, gently mixed with the creaminess of white peach and a delicate floral bouquet of jasmine and blue freesia, over a woody background, lightly shaped by cashmere and white musk.

Notes:
Top: bergamot, pink grapefruit.
Heart: white peach, blue freesia.
Base: cedar, musk.
